question: The powerhouse of the cell is called as-

question: The largest bone in the body is -

question: Which part of the brain is also known as the “center of respiration”

question: The oxygen-rich blood gets pumped into the body from the heart through-

question: Which system triggers the Fight / Flight response?

question: How many kaals are there in a year?
description: In Yoga, a year is mainly divided into 2 Kālas: 1. Uttarayana Kāla (Northern movement of Sun) 2. Dakshinayana Kāla (Southern movement of Sun). Uttarayana: Mid-January → Mid-July.  Energy moves upward & outward. Body becomes weaker (energy gets depleted). Includes: Shishira (late winter), Vasanta (spring), Grishma (summer). In yoga: Practice should be moderate. Avoid over-exertion. Focus on cooling & balancing practices. Dakshinayana: Mid-July → Mid-January. Energy moves inward & downward. Body becomes stronger & nourished. Includes: Varsha (monsoon), Sharad (autumn), Hemanta (early winter). In yoga: Good time for strong practice. Build strength, stamina, deeper sadhana.
